evidence_role: Existing transistor circuits and replays characterize device/block behavior under their recorded conditions. They are not a second normative architecture or evidence that the selected complete transceiver schematic is implemented.

Behavioral rail gating and missing reverse junctions do not establish shutdown, power-off isolation or safe stress. Preserve this gap until actual junction paths and local controls are implemented.

primary_protection.decision: Retain the canonical isolated-rail primary protection networks as the first-pass baseline. Complete protection-to-core coordination, physical discharge-current paths and safe-state controls. Layout/device-graph agreement and compact-model pulse response establish neither ESD qualification nor core survival.
primary_protection.scope: Five canonical pad families include primary protection. Use their canonical extracted models and retained-state reports; the earlier small-clamp dimensional audit is historical diagnostic evidence, not the selected implementation status.
primary_protection.implementation: RF RX/TX use extracted steering diodes, an isolated protection rail, native-derived clamp, MIM timing/storage capacitors and physical bleed. Each RF pair reserves 130000 um2. Wired TX, RX/USB and differential reference also include primary protection in their canonical generated layouts. Attached RF and reference cores remain behavioral boundaries; primary-to-core coordination and whole-ring/package current paths are incomplete.

core_boundary_policy.normal_operation: Use each shared architecture block and retained external network for common-mode, swing, loading and power. Protection must preserve those operating conditions.
core_boundary_policy.power_transitions: Evaluate each connected core against its local rails during reset, brownout, unpowered and reconfiguration states; external coupling capacitors do not eliminate retained charge or external excitation.
core_boundary_policy.transient_survival: Unqualified until actual attached devices and allowed terminal voltage/current versus duration are established. Neither nominal device voltage labels nor behavioral rail clipping supply a survival limit.
core_boundary_policy.implementation_gate: Include secondary protection or isolation wherever the primary network cannot meet the attached-device contract. Account for its capacitance, resistance, current path and area in the same generated family, rather than adding an ideal clamp only in the bench.

Negative unpowered termination-enable voltage requires stress/recovery analysis. Other serializer/bias fanout and supply qualification remain behavioral; no safe-state acceptance.

connected_terminal_exposure.finding: 4.079V gate-drain exposure during32.2ns supply collapse in3.3V control devices. Requires power-domain interface and internal transient treatment before adoption; no reliability verdict inferred.

tolerant_input_candidate.finding: Keep thick-oxide input treatment as candidate direction; change internal/output transient handling before adoption. Collapse4.126V exposure is on06v0 inputs;03v3 internal gate-source still reaches3.825V on release. Prescribed2ns blanking removes measured above-threshold conflict at50/500fF; hardware sequencing absent.

thick_logic_candidate.finding: Preferred88MOS06v0static interlock. Local layout/static checks pass and connected lifecycle completes. Measured max|Vgd|4.151V,max|Vgs|4.095V;no oxide lifetime verdict.4ns prescribed blanking clears tested50/500fF threshold overlap. Physical sequencer, supervisor and fanout still missing.

transaction_sequencer.status: RTL behavior verified with Icarus; synthesis/layout and extracted mixed-signal connection pending
transaction_sequencer.contract: Synchronous commit/request/analog_ready; async disable on reset or invalid local supply; synchronized release required. Preblank, atomically apply captured request, postblank, wait current-configuration analog readiness. Buffer request independent of qualified. Invalid command disables; loss of readiness faults; no automatic rearm.
transaction_sequencer.remaining: Physical readiness/supply detectors, clock/count budget including detector latency, benign serializer startup behavior, synthesis/layout and broader loaded-operation/variation coverage; nominal extracted transition and MAIN+POST hold replays now converge.

connected_replay.finding: Actual RTL outputs drive extracted interlock/fullTX/buffer, same external network. Open-loop readiness only. Precharge peak2.362V; sampled loaded MAIN/MAINPOST errors121/130mV. Sequencing does not close analog startup; no readiness acceptance.

transaction_sequencer.loaded_readiness: QUALIFIED enables analog load; TRAFFIC_READY asserts only after LOAD_CYCLES contiguous good analog_ready samples under load. Startup bad sample restarts dwell without removing load; readiness loss after traffic-ready faults. RTL checks pass; earlier open-loop replay predates this update.

readiness_observation.finding: 50.92ns loaded traffic-ready without measured detector ready; sampled MAINPOST never measured-ready. Updated RTL replay is open-loop; prescribed analog_ready is not acceptable proof. Comparator physical implementation, offset/loading/current absent.

feedback_iteration.finding: Sampled feedback converges with all four requested modes reaching traffic-ready and final disable observed. No loaded traffic-ready interval without detector readiness. Short transition fixture only; see explicit per-mode dwell durations. Physical detectors and sustained-operation verification remain open.

loaded_hold.finding: Direct MAIN+POST startup reaches traffic-ready and holds for 68 ns with converged sampled feedback, maximum 14.12 mV reference error within 16.5 mV allocation, then disables. Repetitive nominal test only; physical detectors, variation, longer operation and other configurations remain.

generation_parameters.status: selected shared first-pass construction recipes; electrical acceptance remains separate
generation_parameters.scope: Single recipe for chosen circuit sizing. Primary protection, core bleed, compensation and provider assembly are composed by their existing layout generators; this recipe alone is not a complete extracted pad.

tx_integration_fixture.status: nominal retained-network engineering fixture, not a protocol profile or calibrated production trim

transmit_primary.implemented_scope: Canonical 366-device protected pad, connected extracted buffer/interlock and RTL-driven retained-state replay; normal build entry point checks layout graph, area, sampled convergence and provider placement.
transmit_primary.remaining: Buffer/interlock placement and area, physical detectors/sequencer, protection/core contract, updated AC/current calibration and sustained operation.

steering_output_routing.scope: First-pass M4/M5 steering output routes; actual parasitic timing and integrated DRC/LVS remain required.

wired_transmit.scope: Selected current-carrying bus widths; regeneration and routed resistance/capacitance acceptance required. Width alone does not qualify vias or electromigration.

foundation_and_attachments.physical_foundation: Existing isolated-rail primary-protection macro and provider-compatible bond geometry; shared local-safety requirements do not imply implemented supervisors.
foundation_and_attachments.decision: Select reusable foundation with lean functional attachments. Five current use-site families are not a fixed cell-count requirement. Retain specialized wired attachments: simple union and shared-termination candidates fail the RX loading allocation before new routing. Keep RF receive/reference structural sharing as a candidate; do not populate RF pads with wired branches.
foundation_and_attachments.promotion_gate: Same fully populated candidate must meet shared loading, impedance and signal-quality requirements and retained-network off-state safety, including all disabled branches, physical core interfaces and routing. Current RF/reference cores are loading assumptions, not complete transistor implementations.
foundation_and_attachments.simultaneity: Cell reuse does not remove the need for separate physical instances for simultaneous independent lanes. Current pin and packaging plan remains selected.
